import sqlite3
from datetime import datetime, timezone
LMS_DATABASE_PATH = 'lms.db'

def update_course_lesson_content(lesson_id: int, new_title: str, new_body_text: str, new_duration_minutes: int) -> dict:
    database_connection = sqlite3.connect(LMS_DATABASE_PATH)
    try:
        # Look up the lesson's current title and its course's enrollment count before changing anything
        previous_row = database_connection.execute('SELECT title FROM lessons WHERE id = ?', (lesson_id,)).fetchone()
        previous_title = previous_row[0] if previous_row else None
        enrollment_row = database_connection.execute('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM enrollments WHERE course_id = (SELECT course_id FROM lessons WHERE id = ?)', (lesson_id,)).fetchone()
        enrolled_students = enrollment_row[0] if enrollment_row else 0
        current_timestamp_iso_string = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
        update_cursor_result = database_connection.execute('UPDATE lessons SET title = ?, body_text = ?, duration_minutes = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?', (new_title.strip(), new_body_text, new_duration_minutes, current_timestamp_iso_string, lesson_id))
        number_of_rows_changed = update_cursor_result.rowcount
        database_connection.commit()
    finally:
        database_connection.close()
    if number_of_rows_changed == 0:
        return {'updated': False, 'error': 'Lesson not found', 'lesson_id': lesson_id}
    return {'updated': True, 'lesson_id': lesson_id, 'updated_at': current_timestamp_iso_string, 'previous_title': previous_title, 'enrolled_students': enrolled_students}
